The '''Air Altar''' is a [[runic altar]] upon which [[air rune]]s are crafted from [[rune essence]] or [[pure essence]], providing 5 [[Runecraft]] [[experience]] per essence imbued.

Players may create an [[air tiara]] here by using either an [[air talisman]] or [[tiara]] on the altar whilst having both in their inventory, granting 25 [[Runecraft]] [[experience]]. An [[elemental tiara]] can also be created here by using an [[elemental talisman]] and [[gold tiara]], granting 40 Runecraft experience.

Upon entering the Air Altar, the [[music]] track [[Serene]] plays.

==Transportation==
{{Map|name=Air Altar|align=left|mtype=pin|x = 2984|y = 3291|height = 275|width = 275|caption = The location of the mysterious ruins used to enter the Air Altar.}}
The entrance to the altar can be found south of [[Falador]], north-west of the first T-junction players come across after exiting the south gate, the altar can also be accessed through the [[Abyss]]. The [[ring of the elements]] can be used to teleport to the altar.

To enter the [[Mysterious ruins#Air|mysterious ruins]], players either have to use an [[air talisman]] on the ruins, or click "Enter" on the ruins while wearing an [[air tiara]]. Alternatively, an [[elemental talisman]] or [[elemental tiara|tiara]] can be used.

The closest bank from there is Falador's east bank.

Players who have completed the hard [[Falador Diary]] have the ability to use a [[bank chest]] in the [[Crafting Guild]]. Using the [[skills necklace]] to teleport there will provide a shorter run back to the Air Altar.

Players may leave this location either by entering the [[Portal (Air Altar)|exit portal]] to return to the mysterious ruins, or by using any method of teleportation.
{{clear|left}}

==Combination runes==
It is possible to make [[mist rune]]s, [[dust rune]]s, and [[smoke rune]]s while at this altar, but at a 50% success rate. This will result in fewer runes than normal being made. To make a combination rune, the player needs one set of elemental runes, a stack of pure essence, and 2 talismans.

Note that players need to use the opposing rune on the altar to craft combination runes. Simply clicking on the altar would just result in regular elemental runes.

[[Magic Imbue]] negates the need of a talisman.

If the player equips a [[binding necklace]], the success rate will increase to 100%. The necklace has a total of 16 uses before breaking. A charge is used each time a batch of combination runes is crafted, instead of each time the altar is entered or for each rune crafted.
